notes:
New videos default to four seconds at the quality preset. Describe a duration in the prompt to generate a video up to three minutes. The field monitor shows which seconds are being created.

Use Extend on a completed generated clip to build a longer version. The previous footage stays intact. Each new segment uses the last decoded frame of the previous segment, and every completed version is a separate Recent clips entry.

Source commit db829940d13e62b579b421087b47352d5987b714.

Verified real 4-, 8- and 16-second renders on an RTX 3060. Both extensions preserve every previously decoded frame. The 16-second render also matched both continuation inputs pixel for pixel against the preceding segment’s last frame. A separate 45-segment test verified 180 seconds of MP4 assembly and 44 frame handoffs with controlled source footage.
